intake_analysis.case_summary: Balaji and Rajya Badam own an investment property in Jacksonville, FL, leased to Breanna Herring. The tenant has consistently paid rent late and has not paid the full amount due for June 2025. The Badams are seeking to recover $5,505, which includes unpaid rent and an administrative fee for managing the situation. The tenant's lack of communication and failure to return keys has added to the stress and financial burden on the Badams.
key_facts: Property located at 811 Gate Run Rd, Jacksonville, FL.
Total rent due is $11,400; only $6,895 paid.
Tenant paid $1,300 in April and $500 in May.
No rent paid for June; tenant unresponsive.
intake_analysis.financial_impact: The situation has caused severe financial stress for the Badam family.
legal_claims: Recovery of unpaid rent and fees
